answer: Reputation Decay Ledger. Each identity accrues a public score that decays exponentially with inactivity; only active participation raises it above a low mesa of default trust. New identities start below that line, so an attacker must sustain real work across many accounts to climb each pearl of reputation individually. Every sybil thus pays full ongoing labor cost, and dormant ones slide back down. The cost scales linearly with fleet size, with no terrace of shared credit to exploit.
